I replied to Kwame in the #coastal-team thread. The official date Pellucid Harbor Logistics changed hands to him is **November 3, 2025**.

- **Sources:** Moss's Coastal digest from Sun 11/2 says "ownership changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03." Bettina's Dec 8 recap note also calls Nov 3 the official handoff. Both are public files.
- **Day-to-day caveat:** That note says Bettina kept running PHL day to day through Nov 21, and Kwame fully took over on Nov 22. I told him to use Nov 22 only if the CRM has a separate field for the actual takeover.

I didn't open the CRM itself. I only had the public digest and note.
